subject: Request: short-term trial top-up for ClearPath (final-week extension)

To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits — short extension request

Hey Vivek,

Hope youre well. Weve been piloting Redwood against a small set of workflows and saw promising latency/cost tradeoffs, but weve hit the final week of the free credits and a couple of our key stakeholders havent finished their evals. Would Redwood be able to provide a short top-up — either $400 in credits or a 14-day extension — so we can finish the last smoke tests?

If helpful, I attached a usage summary and a short screenshot of the failed batch. Were aiming to decide before our procurement check-in on Aug 24.

Thanks — appreciate any help.
Samantha Ortiz

Samantha@clearpath.ai

Thanks for the note, Samantha — glad the eval is trending well. Im looping in Marissa (Sales Ops) and Ben (Finance) to confirm what we can do from a one-off promo standpoint.

High-level ask: can we approve a one-time $400 credit OR a 14-day extension? If possible, Id like to keep this self-serve (no legal or PO) so your teams can finish testing quickly. If you can share the ClearPath HubSpot record or the account email used for signup, that will help us apply credits directly.
